predecessors.name: Sun Ce
predecessors.text: Jiangdong: the commanderies of Danyang, Wu, Kuaiji, Yuzhang and Luling that Sun Ce conquered between 194 and 199 and Sun Quan inherited in 200

successors.name: Jin dynasty (Western and Eastern Jin)
successors.text: all of Wu: Yang, Jing, Jiao and Guang, 'four provinces, 43 commanderies and 313 counties', passed to the Jin on Sun Hao's surrender

rulers.name: Sun Quan (Emperor Da)
rulers.title: Marquis of Nanchang 219, King of Wu from 23 September 221, Emperor from 23 May 229

ledger.x: 207: Sun Quan's Jiangdong is Cliopatria's Eastern Wu row.
208: Huang Zu is beaten.
208: Red Cliffs.
209: Zhou Yu takes Jiangling.
209: the middle Yangtze settles with Jiangling in Wu's hands.
210: Jiaozhi submits to Wu.
211: Sun Quan 'moved headquarters from Dantu to Moling in 211 and renamed the city Jianye in 212'.
215: the Xiang River partition.
219: Lü Meng takes Jing.
221: Shu invades Wu to avenge Guan Yu.
221: Sun Quan becomes King of Wu under Wei.
222: Xiaoting.
222: the capital is Wuchang.
222: Wei attacks Wu.
222: Sun Quan declares Wu independent of Wei.
223: the Dongkou and Jiangling battles end without a change of frontier.
227: Shi Hui resists the division of Jiao.
227: Shi Xie's family ceases to rule Jiaozhi for Wu: 'The following day, Lü Dai lured the Shi brothers into a trap during a banquet.'
227: Wu takes direct rule of Jiao and Guang.
227: the Shi family is destroyed and the division of Jiao and Guang stands.
228: the battle of Shiting on the Wei front.
228: Shiting ends without a change of frontier.
229: Sun Quan 'moved the capital from Wuchang to Jianye in 229'.
229: Sun Quan declares himself emperor.
248: Jiaozhi and Jiuzhen rebel.
248: Lady Triệu is defeated 'after several months' and takes her own life.
265: Sun Hao moves the court to Wuchang.
266: the court returns to Jianye.
279: Jin invades Wu from six directions.
3 April 280: Jiangling falls.
April 280: Jiao and Guang surrender.
1 May 280: Jianye falls and Sun Hao surrenders.
May 280: the war ends with Wu's surrender.
280: Eastern Wu ends.

wars.name: Battle of Red Cliffs
wars.outcome: Cao Cao is beaten; Zhou Yu captures Jiangling in 209; Jing Province is divided.

wars.name: Lü Meng's invasion of Jing Province
wars.outcome: Sun Quan takes Liu Bei's Jing holdings; Guan Yu is executed.

wars.name: Battle of Xiaoting
wars.outcome: Lu Xun defeats Liu Bei; Jing stays Wu's.

wars.name: Wei-Wu border wars of the 220s
wars.outcome: Dongkou (222-223), Jiangling (223), Shiting (228); no change of frontier.

wars.name: Lü Dai's reconquest of Jiaozhi
wars.outcome: The Shi family is destroyed; Jiao and Guang provinces are divided and ruled directly.

wars.name: Wu's relief of Shu
wars.outcome: Wu's attacks of 8 January 264 and on Yong'an in about March 264 are withdrawn; no land changes hands.

wars.name: Conquest of Wu by Jin
wars.outcome: Jin wins: Jiangling 3 April, Wuchang mid-April, Jiao and Guang surrender in April, Jianye and Sun Hao 1 May 280.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a border.
